provider: Yahoo Finance chart API (EOD/actions/macro/fundamentals) + AngelOne (NSE token master)
universe_note: A current NSE large/liquid-cap proxy discovered via yfinance screening, reconciled to AngelOne tokens. This is NOT point-in-time NIFTY200 membership: it has no delisted/dropped names and is dated 2026-09-01, so it carries survivorship bias. Labelled as such everywhere it is used.

feature_panel.sector_coverage_note: ticker_meta sector/industry enrichment was never run for this universe; sector-relative momentum and max_sector_weight constraints degenerate to a single unnamed sector until this is populated.

sealed_holdout.storage: data/research/nifty_holdout_sealed/*.parquet (2025-09 through 2026-09 monthly partitions), physically removed from data/features/ so features.load_features() cannot return holdout rows by accident.

hash_method: sha256 of a sorted (token,date,close) CSV rendering; recomputing after any repartition or reload must reproduce these values exactly, or the corresponding split has changed.
